example.zh: 很少有人知道他巨大成功背后的秘密。

example.en: Farmers are working hard in the field to grow more rice.
example.zh: 农民们正在田里辛勤耕作以种出更多稻米。

mnemonic: fie+ld(谐音“陆地”)→田地在陆地上

example.en: Today is the fifth day of our English training camp.
example.zh: 今天是我们英语夏令营的第五天。

example.en: They fight for equal rights in our society.
example.zh: 他们为社会中的平等权利而斗争。

meanings: v. 出现； 合乎情理； 计算； 认为， 猜想
n. 数字；人物；算术；体形，体态；轮廓；画像，塑像；图，图形

example.en: The latest figure shows that unemployment has fallen this year.
example.zh: 最新数字显示今年失业率下降了。

mnemonic: fig(塑造)+ure→塑造出的人物形象

example.en: Please keep these documents in a safe file for future use.
example.zh: 请把这些文件保存在一个安全的档案里以备后用。

mnemonic: file音似“法老”→档案归法老管

example.en: Please fill the bottle with water before you go out.
example.zh: 出门前请把瓶子装满水。

example.en: This film tells the story of a young man chasing his dream.
example.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个年轻人追梦的故事。

example.en: The final exam will take place at the end of next month.
example.zh: 期末考试将在下月底举行。

example.en: After years of hard work, he finally achieved his goal.
example.zh: 经过多年的努力，他终于实现了目标。

example.en: They found the lost wallet near the bus stop.
example.zh: 他们在公交站附近找到了丢失的钱包。

meanings: 发现； 调查的结果； 裁决

example.en: The finding of the survey surprised everyone in the company.
example.zh: 这项调查的结果让公司所有人都很惊讶。

example.en: The driver was fined two hundred yuan for speeding.
example.zh: 这名司机因超速被罚款两百元。

example.en: She wears a ring on her left ring finger.
example.zh: 她在左手无名指上戴了一枚戒指。

example.en: I need to finish my homework before watching television.
example.zh: 我得先完成作业再看电视。

example.en: A big fire broke out in the old building last night.
example.zh: 昨晚那栋旧楼发生了一场大火。

example.en: He works for a large law firm in the center of the city.
example.zh: 他在市中心一家大型律师事务所工作。

mnemonic: firm本义“坚固”→根基坚固的公司

example.en: The first step to success is to set a clear goal.
example.zh: 成功的第一步是设定明确的目标。

example.en: Fish is rich in protein and good for our health.
example.zh: 鱼肉富含蛋白质，对健康有益。

example.en: This key doesn't fit the lock, so we need another one.
example.zh: 这把钥匙配不上锁，我们需要另一把。

example.en: There are five apples left on the table for the children.
example.zh: 桌上还剩五个苹果给孩子们。

example.en: The mechanic fixed my bike in less than half an hour.
example.zh: 修理工不到半小时就修好了我的自行车。

example.en: The national flag is raised every morning at the school gate.
example.zh: 校门口每天早晨都升国旗。

mnemonic: flag音似“扶拉杆”→旗杆上扶旗

meanings: vi. 闪， 闪烁； 飞驰

example.en: A flash of lightning lit up the whole sky.
example.zh: 一道闪电照亮了整个天空。

meanings: adv. 平直地； 直截了当地
adj. 平的；固定的；漏气的；平淡的；沉闷的；浅的
n. 一套房间，单元住宅

example.en: They live in a small flat near the railway station.
example.zh: 他们住在火车站附近的一套小公寓里。

example.en: The wolf feeds on the flesh of small animals.
example.zh: 狼以小动物的肉为食。

example.en: Our flight was delayed because of the heavy fog.
example.zh: 我们的航班因大雾延误了。

example.en: There is a beautiful carpet on the floor of the living room.
example.zh: 客厅地板上铺着一块漂亮的地毯。

mnemonic: floor音似“富饶”→富饶之地铺地板

example.en: Many flowers bloom in the garden every spring.
example.zh: 每年春天花园里许多花盛开。

example.en: A fly landed on the bread while no one was watching.
example.zh: 没人注意时一只苍蝇落在了面包上。

example.en: Please focus your attention on what the teacher is saying.
example.zh: 请把注意力集中在老师说的话上。

example.en: Follow this road and you will reach the train station.
example.zh: 沿着这条路走你就能到火车站。

example.en: Please answer the following questions according to the passage.
example.zh: 请根据文章回答下列问题。

meanings: 食物，食品；养料，精神食粮

example.en: Good food and enough sleep are essential for our health.
example.zh: 良好的食物和充足的睡眠对健康至关重要。

mnemonic: food音似“富得”→富得流油好食物

example.en: Don't be a fool and believe everything you read online.
example.zh: 别做傻子，网上看到什么都信。

mnemonic: fool音似“父哦”→傻爸爸被人愚弄

example.en: He hurt his foot while playing football yesterday.
example.zh: 他昨天踢足球时伤了脚。

example.en: Millions of people around the world enjoy watching football matches.
example.zh: 全世界数百万人喜欢看足球比赛。

example.en: This gift is for my mother on her birthday.
example.zh: 这份礼物是送给我妈妈过生日的。

meanings: vt. 强迫；用力推动，用力打开
n. 军队， 兵力； 暴力， 武力； 力， 力气； 影响力， 效力

example.en: The bad weather forced us to cancel the outdoor activity.
example.zh: 恶劣天气迫使我们取消了户外活动。

example.en: Learning a foreign language opens the door to a new world.
example.zh: 学习一门外语打开了通往新世界的大门。

example.en: Many rare animals live in the forest and need our protection.
example.zh: 许多珍稀动物生活在森林里，需要我们的保护。

example.en: True friendship can last forever if both sides value it.
example.zh: 如果双方都珍惜，真正的友谊可以永存。

example.en: Don't forget to bring your student card to the exam.
example.zh: 别忘了带学生证参加考试。

mnemonic: for(离开)+get(得到)→得到又离开→忘记

example.en: She decided to forgive him for what he had done wrong.
example.zh: 她决定原谅他所犯的错误。

mnemonic: for(完全)+give(给予)→完全给予谅解

example.en: Please fill in this form with your personal information.
example.zh: 请在这张表格上填写你的个人信息。

example.en: The former president gave a speech at the university.
example.zh: 前总统在大学的发表了一场演讲。

example.en: He spent a fortune buying a house in the city center.
example.zh: 他花了一大笔钱在市中心买了套房子。

example.en: We look forward to hearing from you soon.
example.zh: 我们期待尽快收到你的来信。

example.en: The university was founded in 1898 and has a long history.
example.zh: 这所大学创立于1898年，历史悠久。

mnemonic: found与find同源，本义'打下地基'→创立

example.en: There are four seasons in a year, and each has its own beauty.
example.zh: 一年有四个季节，每个季节都有其独特的美。

example.en: He finished fourth in the race, just behind the leading group.
example.zh: 他在比赛中获得第四名，紧挨着领先集团。

example.en: The farmer built a fence to keep the fox away from his chickens.
example.zh: 农夫筑了篱笆，防止狐狸靠近他的鸡。

mnemonic: fox狡猾如'福克斯'，谐音联想

example.en: France is famous for its wine, cheese, and beautiful countryside.
example.zh: 法国以葡萄酒、奶酪和美丽的乡村闻名。

example.en: To be frank, I don't think this plan will work well.
example.zh: 坦白说，我认为这个计划行不通。

mnemonic: Frank也是人名'弗兰克'，直率的人常用名

example.en: Students can use the library for free during the vacation.
example.zh: 假期里学生可以免费使用图书馆。

example.en: People moved to the new land in search of freedom and opportunity.
example.zh: 人们移居新大陆，追寻自由和机遇。

example.en: Water will freeze at zero degrees Celsius under normal conditions.
example.zh: 在正常条件下，水在零摄氏度结冰。

example.en: She is learning French because she plans to study in Paris.
example.zh: 她正在学法语，因为她打算去巴黎留学。

example.en: The market sells fresh fruit and vegetables every morning.
example.zh: 这个市场每天早上都卖新鲜果蔬。

example.en: We usually have a class meeting on Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 我们通常在星期五下午开班会。

mnemonic: Friday源自古英语'弗丽嘉之日'，北欧女神

example.en: A true friend will stand by you when you are in trouble.
example.zh: 真正的朋友会在你困难时支持你。

example.en: The people in this small town are friendly to visitors.
example.zh: 这个小镇的人对游客很友好。

example.en: Their friendship began when they were roommates in college.
example.zh: 他们的友谊始于大学同住一室的日子。

example.en: She traveled from Beijing to Shanghai by high-speed train.
example.zh: 她乘高铁从北京到上海旅行。

mnemonic: from...to...，固定搭配表起点到终点

example.en: He sat in the front row so that he could see the blackboard clearly.
example.zh: 他坐在前排，这样能看清黑板。

example.en: Eating more fruit is good for your health.
example.zh: 多吃水果有益健康。

example.en: The bus was so full that we had to wait for the next one.
example.zh: 公交车太挤了，我们不得不等下一班。

example.en: The students had great fun at the school party last night.
example.zh: 昨晚学生们在学校派对上玩得很开心。

meanings: 葬礼， 丧礼， 丧葬

example.en: Hundreds of people attended the writer's funeral to say goodbye.
example.zh: 数百人参加了这位作家的葬礼，向他告别。

example.en: The movie was so funny that everyone laughed out loud.
example.zh: 这部电影太滑稽了，大家都放声大笑。

example.en: We need further discussion before making the final decision.
example.zh: 在做最终决定前，我们需要进一步讨论。

mnemonic: further是far的比较级，也可指'进一步'

example.en: No one knows what the future will bring, so we should work hard.
example.zh: 没人知道未来会怎样，所以我们应该努力。

mnemonic: future像'富车子'，未来富裕联想

example.en: The basketball game attracted thousands of fans to the stadium.
example.zh: 这场篮球赛吸引了数千名球迷来到体育馆。

mnemonic: game既指游戏也指比赛，一鱼两吃

meanings: vi. 聚集， 结成一伙

example.en: A gang of teenagers was making noise outside the store.
example.zh: 一伙年轻人在商店外面吵闹。

mnemonic: gang音似'岗'，一帮人站岗扎堆

example.en: He keeps his car and some tools in the garage behind the house.
example.zh: 他把车和一些工具放在屋后的车库里。

mnemonic: garage音'嘎拉吉'，车库大门嘎啦响

meanings: 垃圾， 废物； 废话； 无用的资料

example.en: Please remember to take the garbage out before you leave.
example.zh: 离开前请记得把垃圾带出去。

mnemonic: garbage谐音'轧不碎'，垃圾难处理

example.en: My grandmother grows flowers and vegetables in her garden.
example.zh: 我奶奶在花园里种花种菜。

example.en: The price of gas has risen sharply this year.
example.zh: 今年汽油价格大幅上涨。

mnemonic: gas三种含义：气体、煤气、汽油

example.en: Please wait for me at the school gate after class.
example.zh: 下课后请在校门口等我。

example.en: The family gathered together to celebrate the old man's birthday.
example.zh: 全家人聚在一起庆祝老人的生日。

mnemonic: gather像'攒'，把散的东西收集起来

example.en: The streets were full of gay music and colorful flags during the festival.
example.zh: 节日期间街道上满是欢快的音乐和彩旗。

mnemonic: gay古义'快乐'，如白雪公主题名

meanings: n. 齿轮，传动装置，排挡；用具，设备；衣服
vt. 使适应， 使适合

example.en: The machine stopped because one of the gears was broken.
example.zh: 机器停了，因为一个齿轮坏了。

mnemonic: gear音'吉尔'，齿轮咬合'咯吱'响

example.en: The manager gave us a general idea of the new project.
example.zh: 经理向我们大致介绍了新项目。

meanings: 天才， 天赋， 天资； 天才人物

example.en: Einstein was a genius whose ideas changed the world.
example.zh: 爱因斯坦是一位改变世界的科学天才。

mnemonic: genius源自拉丁语'出生时的天赋'

example.en: The gentleman offered his seat to the elderly lady on the bus.
example.zh: 这位绅士在公交车上给老妇人让座。

mnemonic: gentle温柔的+man男人→彬彬有礼的君子

example.en: He is studying German history at the university.
example.zh: 他在大学学习德国历史。

mnemonic: German德国的，germany德国，注意大小写

example.en: Germany is known for its cars, beer, and classical music.
example.zh: 德国以汽车、啤酒和古典音乐闻名。

meanings: 获得，得到；到达；变成，成为

example.en: I usually get up at seven and get to school by eight.
example.zh: 我通常七点起床，八点到校。

mnemonic: get万能动词：得到、到达、变得

example.en: The old house is said to be visited by a ghost at midnight.
example.zh: 据说那座老宅半夜有鬼魂出没。

mnemonic: ghost谐音'勾死他'，鬼勾人联想

meanings: 〔儿童故事中的〕巨人；巨人；巨物
n. 巨人，巨物；才智超群的人

example.en: A giant panda was born in the zoo last month.
example.zh: 上个月动物园出生了一只大熊猫。

mnemonic: giant音'检疫的'巨物，联想'巨无霸'

example.en: She received many gifts on her eighteenth birthday.
example.zh: 她十八岁生日收到很多礼物。

mnemonic: gift双义：礼物与天赋，都是'上天所赐'

example.en: The little girl in red is my neighbor's daughter.
example.zh: 那个穿红衣服的小女孩是我邻居的女儿。

example.en: He decided to give away most of his money to charity.
example.zh: 他决定把大部分钱捐给慈善机构。

meanings: adj. 规定的，特定的；假设的；已知的；有癖好的，有倾向的

example.en: Given the bad weather, the outdoor concert was canceled.
example.zh: 考虑到天气恶劣，露天音乐会被取消了。

mnemonic: given常引导条件：鉴于、考虑到

example.en: I am glad to hear that you have passed the exam.
example.zh: 听说你通过了考试，我很高兴。

example.en: She poured a glass of water for the tired traveler.
example.zh: 她为疲惫的旅客倒了一杯水。

mnemonic: glass双义：玻璃材质和玻璃杯

meanings: 光荣， 荣誉的事； 美丽

example.en: The soldiers returned home in glory after winning the war.
example.zh: 战士们胜利后荣耀归来。

example.en: We plan to go camping in the mountains this weekend.
example.zh: 我们计划这个周末去山里露营。

example.en: His goal is to become a doctor and help people in poor areas.
example.zh: 他的目标是当医生，帮助贫困地区的人们。

mnemonic: goal音'够'，目标就是'够得着'的方向

example.en: In the story, the hero asked the gods for help.
example.zh: 故事中，英雄向众神求助。

mnemonic: god神，God上帝，大写首字母区别

example.en: The ring is made of pure gold and is very valuable.
example.zh: 这枚戒指是纯金打造，非常贵重。

mnemonic: gold是名词金，golden是形容词金色

example.en: The setting sun cast a golden light over the wheat field.
example.zh: 夕阳给麦田洒下金色的光辉。

mnemonic: gold加-en后缀，名词变形容词如wooden

example.en: Playing golf has become a popular sport among business people.
example.zh: 打高尔夫球已成为商务人士喜爱的运动。

example.en: Reading is a good way to relax after a long day.
example.zh: 在漫长一天后，阅读是放松的好方式。

meanings: n. 善良， 美德， 好意

example.en: She has a heart full of goodness and always helps others.
example.zh: 她心地善良，总是帮助别人。

example.en: The government has taken measures to reduce air pollution.
example.zh: 政府已采取措施减少空气污染。

meanings: 州长； 主管人员； 理事， 董事

example.en: The governor visited the flood area to comfort the local people.
example.zh: 州长视察洪灾地区，慰问当地民众。

meanings: v. 抓取，攫取；赶紧做；抓住；抓，夺

example.en: Grab the rope tightly before you start to climb.
example.zh: 开始爬之前紧紧抓住绳子。

meanings: n. 优美，优雅；风度，魅力；宽限，缓期

example.en: She moved with grace across the dance floor.
example.zh: 她优雅地走过舞池。

mnemonic: 优雅像微风掠过湖面，轻柔不张扬

example.en: Teachers grade papers before Friday.
example.zh: 老师们在周五前给试卷评分分级。

mnemonic: grad像台阶，一级一级给等级

meanings: 宏伟的； 重大的； 傲慢的； 派头大的； 绝佳的； 全部的

example.en: The city built a grand new library.
example.zh: 这座城市建了一座宏伟的新图书馆。

example.en: My grandfather tells stories every night.
example.zh: 我祖父每晚都讲故事。

example.en: Her grandmother cooks soup on Sundays.
example.zh: 她祖母周日会煮汤。

meanings: vt. 授予， 给予； 同意

example.en: The school will grant him a scholarship.
example.zh: 学校将授予他奖学金。

mnemonic: grant像点头同意，把东西给出去

example.en: The grass is green after the rain.
example.zh: 雨后草地绿油油的。

meanings: 感激的； 令人愉快的

example.en: We are grateful for your warm help.
example.zh: 我们感激你热心的帮助。

meanings: adj. 严重的； 严肃的

example.en: They stood quietly beside the grave.
example.zh: 他们静静站在坟墓旁。

example.en: She made a great progress this term.
example.zh: 她这学期取得了很大进步。

mnemonic: great和grate同音，磨碎奶酪也费力

example.en: The hills look green in spring.
example.zh: 春天山丘看起来一片翠绿。

example.en: The ball fell to the ground.
example.zh: 球掉到了地上。

example.en: Our group meets every Tuesday.
example.zh: 我们小组每周二聚会。

example.en: Plants grow faster in warm weather.
example.zh: 植物在温暖天气里长得更快。

example.en: A dog guards the gate at night.
example.zh: 夜里一只狗看守大门。

example.en: Can you guess the answer?
example.zh: 你能猜出答案吗？

example.en: Every guest received a small gift.
example.zh: 每位客人都收到一份小礼物。

example.en: The guide led us through the museum.
example.zh: 导游带我们参观博物馆。

example.en: He felt guilty about breaking the rule.
example.zh: 他因违规而感到内疚。

example.en: She plays guitar in a band.
example.zh: 她在乐队里弹吉他。

example.en: The police found a gun in the car.
example.zh: 警察在车里发现了一把枪。

example.en: That guy is my new classmate.
example.zh: 那个家伙是我的新同学。

mnemonic: guy口语常用，指身边的家伙

example.en: He goes to the gym after work.
example.zh: 他下班后去健身房。

mnemonic: gym三个字母，联想运动馆招牌

example.en: She has long black hair.
example.zh: 她有一头黑色长发。

example.en: Half of the students passed the test.
example.zh: 一半学生通过了考试。

example.en: The concert was held in the school hall.
example.zh: 音乐会在学校礼堂举行。

example.en: He raised his hand to ask a question.
example.zh: 他举手提问。

meanings: vt. 拿， 触； 操作， 处理

example.en: She can handle the problem alone.
example.zh: 她能独自处理这个问题。

example.en: The actor looks handsome in uniform.
example.zh: 这位演员穿制服很英俊。

mnemonic: handsome像男子出手大方有风度

example.en: Please hang your coat on the hook.
example.zh: 请把外套挂在钩子上。

example.en: We walked along a quiet country lane after dinner.
example.zh: 晚饭后我们沿着一条安静的乡间小路散步。

mnemonic: 联想：lane像窄窄一条线的乡间小路

example.en: English is a useful language for international travel.
example.zh: 英语是一门对国际旅行很有用的语言。

mnemonic: 词根：lingua舌头，语言从舌头来

example.en: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the show.
example.zh: 一大群人聚集在广场上看演出。

mnemonic: 联想：large拉开幅度，规模很大

example.en: She was the last student to leave the classroom.
example.zh: 她是最后一个离开教室的学生。

mnemonic: 联想：last撑到末尾，成为最后

example.en: He was late for class because the bus broke down.
example.zh: 他上课迟到了，因为公交车坏了。

example.en: I have been very busy with my studies lately.
example.zh: 最近我的学习一直很忙。

mnemonic: 词缀：late+ly构成副词，近来这段时间

example.en: We can discuss the plan later after lunch.
example.zh: 我们午饭后再讨论这个计划。

example.en: The funny story made everyone laugh loudly.
example.zh: 这个有趣的故事把大家逗得大笑。

example.en: Her laughter filled the room with joy.
example.zh: 她的笑声让房间充满快乐。

example.en: Everyone should obey the law and respect others.
example.zh: 每个人都应守法并尊重他人。

example.en: The lawyer gave us useful advice about the contract.
example.zh: 律师就合同给了我们很有用的建议。

example.en: Please lay the book on the desk and sit down.
example.zh: 请把书放在桌上然后坐下。

mnemonic: 联想：lay=放下，laid是它的过去式

example.en: The pipe is made of lead, so it is very heavy.
example.zh: 这根管子是铅做的，所以很重。

meanings: 领袖， 领导人， 首领

example.en: A good leader listens to the team before deciding.
example.zh: 好的领导在决定前会听取团队意见。

mnemonic: 词缀：lead+er，走在前面领头的人

meanings: 指导的， 带头的； 最主要的； 饰演主角的

example.en: She is a leading expert in environmental science.
example.zh: 她是环境科学领域首屈一指的专家。

example.en: Our school joined the local football league.
example.zh: 我们学校加入了当地的足球联盟。

mnemonic: 联想：league联盟，大伙联合成一伙

example.en: We learn new words best by using them often.
example.zh: 通过经常使用新单词，我们学得最好。

meanings: 有学问的； 学术上的

example.en: The learned professor gave a clear lecture.
example.zh: 这位博学的教授做了一场清晰的讲座。

meanings: 学习； 学问， 知识

example.en: Learning a language takes time and practice.
example.zh: 学习一门语言需要时间和练习。

example.en: This is the least difficult question in the test.
example.zh: 这是考试中最不难的一道题。

mnemonic: 词根：little最高级到least，少到极点

example.en: We will leave the station at seven tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 我们明早七点将离开车站。

example.en: Turn left at the corner and you will see the bank.
example.zh: 在拐角向左转，你就会看到银行。

mnemonic: 形近：leave过去式left，留下又在左边

example.en: He hurt his leg while running on the playground.
example.zh: 他在操场跑步时伤了腿。

mnemonic: 联想：leg像两条腿迈步的形状

example.en: You should get legal advice before signing the paper.
example.zh: 签文件前你应咨询法律意见。

example.en: The old legend tells of a hero and a hidden treasure.
example.zh: 古老传说讲了一位英雄和一笔宝藏。

mnemonic: 词根：leg讲读，讲着传下来的故事

example.en: We should use less water and save energy every day.
example.zh: 我们每天应少用水并节约能源。

example.en: The first lesson begins at eight in the morning.
example.zh: 第一节课早上八点开始。

mnemonic: 联想：lesson一节课，内容先少一点

example.en: My parents let me choose my own college major.
example.zh: 父母允许我自己选择大学专业。

example.en: She wrote a long letter to her friend abroad.
example.zh: 她给国外的朋友写了一封长信。

mnemonic: 联想：letter一封信由26个字母组成

example.en: The water level rose quickly after the heavy rain.
example.zh: 大雨后水面迅速上涨。

mnemonic: 对称：level正反都平，水面一样高

example.en: Do not trust him; he is a liar who always cheats.
example.zh: 别相信他，他是个总骗人的说谎者。

example.en: I borrowed two novels from the school library.
example.zh: 我从学校图书馆借了两本小说。

example.en: You need a license to drive a car in this city.
example.zh: 在这座城市开车需要执照。

example.en: The cat likes to lie in the sun all afternoon.
example.zh: 这只猫喜欢整个下午躺在阳光下。

example.en: The lieutenant led the soldiers through the forest.
example.zh: 中尉带领士兵穿过森林。

mnemonic: 联想：lieu地方+tenant持有人，副手掌权

example.en: Exercise and sleep are important for a healthy life.
example.zh: 锻炼和睡眠对健康生活很重要。

example.en: Please lift the box carefully; it is quite heavy.
example.zh: 请小心提起这个箱子，它很重。

example.en: This bag is light enough for a small child to carry.
example.zh: 这个包很轻，小孩子也提得动。

example.en: I like reading novels when I have free time.
example.zh: 有空时我喜欢读小说。

mnemonic: 联想：like就是“来磕”喜欢的人

example.en: It is likely to rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
example.zh: 明天可能下雨，所以带把伞。

example.en: Please stand in line and wait for your turn.
example.zh: 请排队等轮到你自己。

example.en: Make a list of the things you need to buy.
example.zh: 把要买的东西列个清单。

example.en: Listen carefully to the teacher in class.
example.zh: 上课时认真听老师讲。

example.en: There is little milk left in the fridge.
example.zh: 冰箱里剩下的牛奶不多了。

example.en: They live in a small town near the sea.
example.zh: 他们住在海边的一个小镇。

example.en: We study living things in biology class.
example.zh: 我们在生物课上研究生物。

example.en: Workers load the boxes onto the truck every morning.
example.zh: 工人们每天早把箱子装上卡车。

example.en: She asked the bank for a loan to buy a house.
example.zh: 她向银行申请贷款买房。
